_about: W020: art-direction notes carried over to the ChatGPT redraw of the 4 chosen sets, from redo round 1 (redo_round1.json) and the W019 final pass. Rephrased as directions, because ChatGPT draws these cards fresh.

love-in-the-city.B04: A smooth, taut, glossy red foil heart with crisp bright highlights (not a puffy, seamed pillow), with a short white ribbon that hangs down with one soft curl and a small pink bow at the knot.

picture-perfect-suburbia.A05: Crisp, clear glass with bright highlights and a visible thick rim, filled with bright creamy-white milk; a bold glossy red cap and a perky red gingham bow on the neck.
picture-perfect-suburbia.A07: Stand the mixer on a clearly realistic polished wooden kitchen countertop with a soft reflection, in front of the plain pink wall.
picture-perfect-suburbia.A08: A warm orange background with clearly visible rays (never teal or cyan) and a thick, chunky hoop tube that reads as a bold oval.
picture-perfect-suburbia.A09: Tilt the tray toward the viewer in a three-quarter view so every compartment is clearly visible; bright, glossy, appetizing stylized food; a bright, saturated sunny-yellow surface and wall, never mustard or beige.

once-upon-a-garden.A10: Keep it simple enough to read at small card size: big smooth stones, a simple roof with a few broad tiles, no small flowers or thin vines.

the-lost-island.C01: Chunky and large, with the sand as a neat heap on the blade and nothing flying off.
the-lost-island.C02: A lantern made of a few big, smooth shapes: no thin wires or rivets, simple clear glass panels, a bright yellow flame and a red cap; the purple wall stays even, with no halo or light spill.
